title: Child Support
paragraphs: “I have already performed the necessary ritual for this egg to exist in the human world. Make sure to register it as its master along with Windia.”
“Oh, okay… But… does that mean all of us heroes?”
“I refuse.”
Becoming a dragon’s master? I’d rather die. If that were the case, I’d rather finish off the rival right here and now.
“You mean just me and Ren?”
“Are we talking about a pet dragon?”
Ren and Itsuki didn’t seem too opposed to the idea, but the rival pointed at Father.
“You.”
“Just me!? Why…?”
“My instincts tell me that entrusting Windia to you is the best choice. As for her living expenses, will this be enough?”
The rival gestured toward the treasure piled on the cart. Ah, so that was for her upbringing. It was the same treasure that the adventurers had stolen last time.
“I’m not exactly struggling for money, so it’s fine, but…”
“Regardless, I am entrusting our fate to you all. I hope you will keep your promise.”
With those words, the rival’s body shimmered like mist before vanishing into light, merging into the egg.
Does he think he’s some kind of god? If anything, he’s more like a lingering ghost.
“Looks like I got singled out for this…”
“Well, Naofumi-san, you’re pretty good at taking care of people. You can cook too, so maybe he sensed that?”
“Now that you mention it, besides Motoyasu, even the Filolials have taken a liking to him.”
Ren and Itsuki reluctantly nodded in agreement.
Is keeping a dragon as a pet really that appealing?
“Speaking of which, remember that time we were resting during our journey, and Motoyasu was out while Naofumi-san was napping under a tree? That group of monsters gathered around him.”
“Oh yeah! We were taking a break outside, and before we knew it, Naofumi was surrounded by monsters.”
“Wait a second! If you noticed, why didn’t you help me!? Were they attacking?”
“The atmosphere made it hard to approach…”
“They all scattered the moment Naofumi-san started waking up, so we just stayed quiet about it. Maybe it’s the same kind of thing?”
Itsuki mumbled something about a supernatural ability.
“So basically, I’m being treated like I’m not a threat, so the monsters don’t even bother being cautious around me?”
“You’re the Shield Hero, so even if they were hostile, they probably wouldn’t find you intimidating.”
“Or maybe they instinctively understand that you have no offensive power. If they know you won’t ever hurt them, it’s not unnatural for them to let their guard down.”
“Yeah, yeah, fine. I’ll take care of that Windia girl and this dragon, then.”
With a sigh, Father placed the egg onto the cart.
“Ugh… The inside of the egg is twitching… It’s kind of gross, almost too lifelike.”
“Maybe it’s getting ready to hatch?”
“Once the registration is complete, it’ll probably pop out all lively.”
“I’ll do my best to level up for its class advancement!”
“Well, we don’t have much choice. Let’s just consider this an investment in the future.”
With that, we made our way back to Yuki and the others.
Now, what should we do with this cart? Yuki and the others seemed put off by the dragon’s scent. By morning, the assistant finally woke up.
“Huh? You’re awake?”

Ren, Itsuki, and Éclair were still asleep. Father had already finished preparing breakfast and was playing with Sakura and the others. I was keeping them company. The assistant looked at Father with obvious displeasure.
“Oh yeah, your father left a few things for you.”
Saying that, Father pulled back the cloth covering the egg and showed it to the assistant.
“I guess you could call this… something he left behind? He asked me to take care of both you and this egg.”
The assistant immediately hugged the egg tightly, holding it as if it were something precious.
“I know you probably hate this, but… Let’s try to understand why your father chose to entrust you to us, okay?”

Before going to sleep last night, Father muttered that maybe recruiting the rival had been a hasty decision. Well, we are heroes, after all. There’s no denying that being around us means being exposed to danger. It’s true that any dragon could have sufficed…
Since it was a direct request from the rival, I hadn’t thought too deeply about it either.
“Let’s start with introductions. My name is Iwatani Naofumi. Just call me Naofumi. I was summoned to this world as the Shield Hero.”

Father spoke to the assistant in a gentle tone. The last time, the assistant had just lost the rival and was about to be taken away by the village adventurers. Since we had shown up right in the nick of time, they hadn’t been too wary of us. But this time, we must seem like enemies who appeared out of nowhere and disrupted their once-happy life, so their guard was up.
“I’ll have the others introduce themselves later when they wake up. The weird guy over there with the spear is Kitamura Motoyasu. And those kids playing behind him are Yuki, Kou, and Sakura.”
The assistant kept checking the egg over and over. Then, she quietly glared at Father.
“…Windia.”
“Yes, your name is Windia-chan.”
“This egg… Father put a spell on it.”
“Looks like it. You can tell?”
“Yeah. Unless both I and… probably you do something, the spell won’t break. I don’t think it’ll hatch otherwise.”
“That’s what he said, huh? But in exchange, it should hatch pretty quickly once we do what’s needed.”
The assistant made a deeply displeased face.
Does she really love the wild that much? Maybe it would be best to put on an act to trick her into coming with us. Like faking the rival’s death and whispering it to the villagers…
Ah, but if we did that, the rival’s subordinates would all be wiped out.
“Windia-chan, why don’t you try coming with us for a while? Your father entrusted you with the hope that you’d see more of the world.”
“…Hmph.”
Oh? The assistant completely ignored Father’s request and turned her face away.
Who does she think she is?
“Are you sure? Because I know a way for you to get back to your father.”
“What!?”
Oh? The assistant, caught by Father’s words, turned around in surprise. Haha, Father is quite the strategist.
“From now on, you’ll grow stronger alongside us. And of course, the little one inside the egg you’re holding so dearly will too.”
“Yeah. So what do I have to do to get back to Father!?”
Humming thoughtfully, Father lowered himself to the assistant’s eye level, smiling like a child.
“Maybe… when you’re strong enough for your father to acknowledge that you’ve truly grown in every way. I think I’ll be able to tell when that moment comes.”
“Strong…?”

“That’s right. Your father is really strong, isn’t he? So if you become strong enough that even he can’t stop you, he won’t be able to hold you back anymore. Of course, he might get mad at you, but still.”
The assistant had a complicated expression. But I don’t think it was just my imagination—there was a spark of motivation in her eyes.

“No matter where you go, I think your father’s real wish is for you to grow into a dragon he can be proud of. Why don’t you do your best with us so that one day you can return home with your head held high?”
“…Okay, I understand.”
Her cheeks were slightly flushed. As expected of Father. He gave her an impossible goal, filling her with hope. Not that the rival is really all that strong…

But to a child, that’s not something they can see. It doesn’t matter. And besides, since the rival is traveling with us, no matter how hard the assistant tries… unless she somehow becomes a Hero, she’ll never surpass him. In the meantime, she’ll experience life among humans. As expected of Father—his thinking is deep.
“Boo…”
Sakura-chan seemed a little dissatisfied with the addition of the rival and the assistant to our group. Even last time, she never openly complained, but she did seem stressed about it.
“Looking forward to traveling with you.”
“Yeah. Please take care of me.”
Father gently smiled and patted the assistant’s head.
